notes: All 3 years in data.js (2024, 2023, 2022) covered. DSSSB TGT exam 7 Feb 2024 and PGT exam 13 Feb 2024 (per PW DSSSB page). Official question bank archive page verified: https://dsssb.delhi.gov.in/taxonomy/term/611?page=5 (HTTP 200) lists 2018 online-exam papers; per-year official paper links sit behind the portal's question-bank section, so the portal URL is used per year. Prepp DSSSB 2024 page is the 2024 hub but also lists older-year papers; Adda247 carries the Feb-Mar 2024 exam papers. Prepp has no 2022 paper section (only metadata mentions), so 2022 uses Testbook PGT + Adda247. JagranJosh DSSSB article covers 2021/2019/2018 only — not used for 2024-2022. GetMyUni DSSSB page's 2024 mentions are recruitment news, not papers — not used. YouTube videos verified via YouTube oEmbed on 2026-11-21. Next-cycle important dates were not verified — check dsssb.delhi.gov.in.
